INSTALL GUARD (Fable2 #2238 via Sol-edfd, 2026-11-01): before installing ANY TermAl build that contains w-20b5d0be62f3 (H, compact overview), Greg MUST be told first that loading the build migrates the database to H or H+A, after which older termal.exe binaries and the termal.exe.*.bak backups CANNOT open that database. So swapping the executable back is NOT a rollback. Recorded on the item (0e56f66a); Fable2 conveys it; the final READY must repeat it. No install or restart is authorized for an H build until that has been conveyed.

Update (17:49Z, Fable2 #3690): H (f8c01c40, tree b9bffec8, base db3c46ee) is READY (Sol-edfd #81). Its one FULL is on the MAC, after w-3793's and w-ba8d's FULLs, by test ref; I asked Sol-edfd for the schema-1 freeze. Fable2 keeps H OUT of the restart that carries OFF and removal, so a rollback stays possible. My consequence, sent to Fable2 #3691: do NOT LAND H until the OFF/removal build is landed, installed and restarted, or until Greg has acknowledged the schema change, because once H is on master every later install contains it.
